Date: 21 August 2026
Venue: J.K.Das Hall (CEMK)
Chief Guest: Dr. Narayan Banerjee, Emeritus Professor, Indian Institute of
Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST), Shibpur


The College of Engineering and Management, Kolaghat (CEMK) opened its new
Astronomy Club on August 21, 2026. The college launched the club during its
National Space Day event. This celebration helped students get excited about

space research. He said student clubs are important for training future

meditation (dhyana). These elements work together to enhance physical
flexibility, build muscle strength, improve posture, and boost energy levels.

title: "A Beautiful Mind" movie screening under COPE
content:
Film Title: A Beautiful Mind
Film Director: Ron Howard
Date of screening: 20.03.2024
Place of screening: TPO conference hall
Number of students attended: 30

Objective of the event: The objective of screening this movie on World Happiness
Day was to provide relevant portrayals of characters struggling with mental
health difficulties, resilience, personal growth, and the pursuit of happiness.

Brief report: Youth Mental Health Club in association with the Aditya Birla
Foundation held a film screening of "A Beautiful Mind" in the TPO conference
hall on 20 March 2024. The movie was around 2 hours 15 minutes long. The movie
was inspired by the life of mathematician John Nash, this biographical drama
depicts his struggles with schizophrenia and his journey toward recovery and
academic success. It offers insights into the challenges of living with mental
illness and the power of perseverance. Students watched the movie and analyzed
various elements that they could see in the film. After the end of the film, a
discussion session was organised where students were asked to opine on what they
felt the relevant. The film screening and discussion ended with a vote of thanks
by the convenor Youth Mental Health Club Committee.
